user.title: Connect to ComfortClick
user.description: Certificate verification is off by default for compatibility with local controllers using self-signed or invalid certificates. Enable it when your controller has a trusted certificate. Without verification, credentials and commands can be intercepted.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller.
error.ssl_error: The certificate could not be verified. Use a trusted certificate matching the controller URL, or disable verification only for a trusted local controller.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_host: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS controller URL without embedded credentials, a query, or a fragment.

init.title: ComfortClick configuration
init.description: Map the fixed building doors, utility meters and ventilation controls. Add separate air conditioners and fans for each room. Existing mappings are loaded automatically.

connection.title: ComfortClick connection
connection.description: Update the controller address and login. Leave Password blank to keep the saved password. Changed login details are checked before saving. Enable certificate verification when your controller has a trusted certificate.

mapping.title: Manage mappings

confirm_remove.title: Remove {name}?
confirm_remove.description: This stops providing this entity. Its registry entry and recorded history are retained; they are not deleted.

fan.title: Fan mapping
fan.description: Choose a cached ComfortClick device path or type one manually. No device commands are sent while configuring. Saving reloads the integration. This fan uses a boolean lock, a boolean heating state, a numeric fan level and two temperature readings.

thermostat.title: Air conditioner mapping
thermostat.description: Choose a cached ComfortClick device path or type one manually. No device commands are sent while configuring. Saving reloads the integration. Leave the fan level path empty for a heating-only thermostat. All temperatures are in Celsius.

utility.title: {name}
utility.description: Edit this fixed meter’s reading path. The slot and its history remain the same. Match the unit to the raw cumulative reading; changing the unit does not rescale it. Leave the path empty if unconfigured. Saving reloads the integration.

fans.title: Fans
fans.description: The stored mappings could not be loaded. Check the integration log for details, then retry.

thermostats.title: Air conditioners
thermostats.description: The stored mappings could not be loaded. Check the integration log for details, then retry.

utilities.title: Utility meters
utilities.description: These five meters are fixed. Choose one to edit its controller path and reading unit.

locks.title: Building doors
locks.description: These three doors belong to the building. Choose a door to edit its controller path. Configuration does not unlock a door.

door.title: {name}
door.description: Edit this building door’s controller path. Leave it empty if unconfigured. Saving reloads the integration and does not send a door command.

ventilation.title: Ventilation
ventilation.description: One instance of each control serves the apartment. Each control can use several underlying controller paths.

vent_mode.title: Ventilation mode
vent_mode.description: Map the three boolean mode paths behind the single ventilation selector. Selecting a mode sends true to its path. Map all three paths to enable the selector. Saving reloads the integration.

vent_air_mode.title: Ventilation air mode
vent_air_mode.description: Map the winter-mode boolean behind the single air selector. True means Warm air; false means Cold air. Leave it empty if unconfigured. Saving reloads the integration.

vent_temperature.title: Ventilation air temperature
vent_temperature.description: One temperature sensor displays the reading for the active ventilation mode. Map the mode paths first, then the relevant temperature readings below. Missing readings remain unavailable. Saving reloads the integration.

doorbell.title: Doorbell
doorbell.description: One ComfortClick Doorbell event is created automatically for this controller. Use it in your doorbell automations. No manual mapping is required. Submit to return to configuration.

error.duplicate_path: This controller path is already mapped in this category. Edit the existing mapping instead.
error.invalid_number: Enter a finite number. The temperature step must be greater than zero.
error.invalid_range: The maximum temperature must be greater than the minimum.
error.invalid_unit: Select a water unit for water, or an energy unit for electricity and heating.
error.cannot_load_mappings: Unable to read the stored mappings. Check the integration log for details.
error.incompatible_meter_type: Water and energy meters cannot share the same history. Add a separate meter mapping for this type.
error.cannot_load_fixed_mappings: An existing mapping could not be assigned uniquely to the fixed slots. No mappings have been changed.
error.invalid_host: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS controller URL without embedded credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller.
error.ssl_error: The certificate could not be verified. Use a trusted certificate matching the controller URL, or disable verification only for a trusted local controller.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.mappings_changed: These mappings changed in another configuration window. Reopen Configure to use the latest values.
abort.fixed_slots: This category has predefined slots. Open its menu to edit a slot; slots cannot be added or removed.
abort.connection_changed: Connection settings changed in another window. Reopen Configure to use the latest values.
